claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.areaOverride relative-area multiplier
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item grants an existing spell with a modified area stated relative to that spell's normal area. The current surface only supports absolute replacement shapes, not relative scaling from the granted spell's authored area.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "The web created by the spell fills twice its normal area."
